sources.entry: 12. PicsArt - Editing, collage making, and drawing.

summary.name: Picsart
summary.one_liner: Picsart is an all-in-one creative platform that combines AI image, video, and audio generation with photo and video editing, templates, and asset libraries.
use_cases: Turn product photos into videos for online stores or social posts
Generate images and video from text prompts
Edit and trim video clips for social channels
Maintain consistent brand visuals for a small business
Automate repeatable image or video workflows
Create assets from AI assistants like ChatGPT or Claude
summary.what_it_does: Picsart offers AI tools to generate images, video, and audio from text descriptions, using a selection of AI models the page says number over 180. It supports turning still images such as product shots into video with added motion. Users can edit and resize clips and build reusable Flows that connect models and steps into automated workflows. The page also describes a Picsart MCP and CLI for connecting its creative tools to assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, and Codex, plus a creator program for earning from content. The page's listing names editing, collage making, and drawing as its core functions.
notable: Access to 180+ AI models for image, video, and audio generation on one subscription
Picsart MCP and CLI connect creative tools to AI assistants and scripts
Flows let users chain models and steps into reusable, automated workflows
Aura takes a plain-language brief and runs the steps to return a finished result
caveats: Paid subscription tiers are listed with per-month prices in INR (Rs 100 and Rs 225 per month, billed yearly; the higher tier is per seat), so full features likely require payment
Platform availability beyond web and the listed assistant integrations is not specified
